notes: ἀπέχοντος is left with only while … was because μακράν carries the predicate's English, off being the adverb's own particle as rule 34 has it; heading a unit on an auxiliary is unusual but nothing lexical remains to it. Giving off to ἀπέχοντος remains defensible.
ἐσπλαγχνίσθη → was moved with compassion heads on the meaning-bearing complement under rules 17 and 91.
